Unforgettable and must do in Hoi An
Jul 2026 • Family
🌿🍳 What an amazing experience at Tra Que Garden Cooking School in Hoi An! 🇻🇳

Our family of five had an unforgettable time learning to prepare some incredible Vietnamese dishes using the freshest ingredients picked straight from the surrounding gardens. 🥭🥕🌱

We made a delicious fresh mango & carrot salad, crispy Vietnamese chicken and prawn bánh xèo (pancakes), fresh prawn and vegetable spring rolls, and they went above and beyond to cater for our vegetarian daughter with tasty tofu and mushroom alternatives. ❤️

As if that wasn’t enough, we were also treated to a generous meal of rice, chicken, aubergine (eggplant), and morning glory, all perfectly paired with ice-cold Huda beers. 🍺😋

Set down a peaceful laneway amongst the working vegetable gardens of Tra Que, the whole experience felt authentic, relaxed and incredibly welcoming.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 100% a must-do when visiting Hoi An! Whether you’re travelling as a couple or with family, you’ll leave with full stomachs, new cooking skills, and wonderful memories. Highly recommended! 🙌🇻🇳

Thanks Ruby for the best cooking experience ever!
Mar 2026 • Couples
This was the best cooking experience we've ever had. Ruby is a fantastic host and cooking teacher. She and Tra Que had no problem catering to us two vegans in a group of five. The tour started with a fascinating shopping excursion through an authentic market for locals and businesses.
We then made our way to the village and were told about all the organic vegetables and herbs growing there. The cooking experience was extremely informative and educational but mostly a lot of fun. Ruby took great photos and videos of us and sent them all (for free) later, which is amazing because we almost never have pictures together. The dishes we made were really delicious and we were quite full by the end.
Such a sweet family run business and one not to miss - highly recommended.

Relax in the quiet of the farms far from the city!
Jul 2025 • Friends
If the city of Hoi An sometimes seems too chaotic, you can take a half day to visit the surrounding countryside by bike where different farms welcome you with various experiences. We chose Tra Que Garden on the advice of friends and were very satisfied. We accompanied the farmers in the gardens, rode buffalo and learned to cook traditional local dishes that we then ate for lunch. Special thanks to our guide Huynh! Alternatively, you can also choose to stop only for lunch.
